    /* 🔴 THE EXCEPTIONAL EXIT SUPERSEDES TOO — the floor under "no path leaves a stale request live".

       tender. Not reachable with valid cart data today, which is exactly why it belongs here rather

       thought to enumerate.

       never a wrong charge.
       It cannot orphan a request that is genuinely in flight: the token is taken immediately before
       fetch(), and the .then/.catch are attached in the same expression with nothing after it — so a
       throw reaching here either happened before issuance, or is fetch() itself failing to issue.
       Case 4 (a request already in flight for this cart) returns normally and never reaches here, so
       its deliberate abstention is untouched. */
    supersedeQuoteRequests();
  }
